archetypes.name: dyn-oos-prompt-contract
archetypes.rationale: Review the revised OOS merit rescue prompt for approval-ordering ambiguity.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the combine-issues OOS prompt changes for contradictions with the merit approval flow. Focus on whether zero-match and multi-match rescue text can accidentally confirm rejections, whether key-only matching is clear, and whether deduplication runs only after confirmed rescues. Also check that the catalog wording does not imply automatic low-merit rejection. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
